body: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.
summaryZh: 现代大模型系统常采用树状或图状的主题事件层级来构建长短期对话记忆。本文利用EverMemBench基准，实验研究了结构深度与供应给回答模型的上下文宽度之间的交互关系。结果表明，增加上下文宽度能显著提升准确率，而增加结构深度并不带来单调增益，这为未来大型连贯上下文块的设计提供了实证依据。
